title: Adjective agreement in the plural genitive
summary: Make an adjective agree with a plural genitive noun: isojen talojen ovi (“the door of the big houses”).
targetSkills: Adjective agreement in the plural genitive
prerequisiteSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive
objectives: Make an adjective agree with a plural genitive noun: isojen talojen ovi (“the door of the big houses”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: An adjective before a noun agrees with that noun in case and number. A later head noun, such as ovi, belongs to a different part of the phrase.
Adjective models: iso → isojen, pieni → pienten/pienien, uusi → uusien, vanha → vanhojen.
The noun forms are talojen and autojen. They are provided in the questions so that the adjective agreement stays central.
keyPoints: Change the adjective as well as the noun.

examples.english: The door of the big houses.
steps: The adjective agrees with talojen: use isojen talojen. Both modifier words are plural genitives.
The surrounding words keep the forms shown; the genitive target expresses this lesson's relationship.
